title: tunnel_auth_zephyr native_sim test panics at thread.c:517 (thread-priority assertion) on clean checkout
description: Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-i838. The tunnel_auth_zephyr native_sim test panics at thread.c:517 (thread-priority assertion) on a clean checkout of ca2f9161d9 — pre-existing native_sim harness issue, independent of the heft shared-workspace merge conflicts (those are resolved). Blocks native_sim verification of tunnel-auth/coap changes on heft. Reproduce: source ~/Developer/lichen-env.sh && west build -b native_sim/native/64 lichen/tests/tunnel_auth_zephyr -p auto && west build -t run.
